messages:
Maya: Quick release train update: small bug in batching scheduler causing rare 99p latency spikes. Requesting freeze-exemption to push a targeted patch tonight.
Ravi: How rare? impact on Dedicated customers?
Maya: ~0.5% of requests at peak, mostly long-sequence embedding jobs. 99p up ~150ms in tests.
Lena: CS wants a heads-up before full roll. We'll notify at 25% if green.
deploy-bot: deploy request queued: repo=runtime-scheduler, branch=fix/batch-edge, target=canary, initiated_by=@Maya
SRE-bot: Canary baseline started (20m). extra trace sampling enabled.
Maya: Plan: baseline 20m -> deploy to canary -> synthetic replay 15m -> 5% for 30m -> 25% -> full. Rollback if 95p >5% regression or error_rate>0.5%.
Ravi: Approved from infra side. :thumbsup:
Maya: Deploying to canary now. Will post smoke results.
deploy-bot: deploy started: runtime-scheduler/canary -> image runtime-scheduler:fix-2026-03-24. build=6589
Maya: Smoke: no crashes, CPU/mem steady, KV cache warmup normal.
SRE-bot: Canary health: PASS. anomaly_score=0.02
Maya: Synthetic replay shows 95p down ~120ms on reproduced traces. Bumping to 5%.
deploy-bot: rollout update: canary -> 5%
Lena: Sending customer note to Dedicated contacts now.
Maya: 5% stable for 30m, moving to 25% and then finish roll over next 60-90m if green.
SRE-bot: Temporary alert "scheduler_tail_latency" active for 6h post-roll.
Maya: Summary: freeze-exemption granted, patch applied to canary, metrics good so far. Will update release changelog when fully rolled. Thanks team.
Lena: Good job, will follow up with CS notes.
